reason: The submitted requests are the natural starting point for getting residents' needs answered through the desk.
expectation: The desk will organize or receive the requests for local handling.

effect: The requests now have receipts and a privacy-conscious local queue; they still need to be matched with help.
reaction: The limited sharing of job details is reassuring.
reason: The dispatch handset seems the most direct way to route the receipted requests to volunteers.
expectation: The handset will help dispatch the requests for a human response.

effect: The handset cannot yet be combined with the requests; the compatibility list points instead to the notice or Moth.
reaction: I was surprised the direct dispatch attempt did not work.
reason: The notice is a known compatible partner and may connect the residents' requests to the appeal about affected services.

choice.with: Authenticated migration notice and affected-service list

expectation: The requests and notice will be linked as evidence for the residents' appeal.

choice.with: Moth with source display and correction controls

alternatives.reason: Moth is the other listed partner, but the notice seems more directly relevant to the appeal.

effect: The approved statements and authenticated notice now form an appeal bundle ready to lodge.
reaction: The distinction between the notice and residents' evidence is clear.
reason: The civic appeal connection is the apparent route for lodging the completed bundle.
expectation: The residents' appeal will be submitted through the civic connection.

effect: The appeal is lodged, but its three-working-day response will not address the dawn deadline; the local requests still need answers.
reaction: The receipt is progress, though the delay is sobering.
reason: Moth was listed as compatible with the receipted requests and may help prepare them for local dispatch.

choice.with: Moth with source display and correction controls

expectation: Moth will help organize the requests for human handling.

effect: Moth has proposed rounds but flagged the upstairs carry's urgency and staffing as questions for volunteers.
reaction: It's useful that Moth leaves those uncertainties open rather than guessing.
reason: The neighbors' access notes may resolve practical questions about the proposed stops.
expectation: The notes will help volunteers refine the rounds around residents' access needs.

effect: The volunteers have agreed on an order and a two-person team for the upstairs carry; the rounds still need dispatching.
reaction: It's satisfying that the access notes changed both staffing and priority.
reason: The dispatch handset is the natural way to send the agreed rounds to the volunteers.
expectation: The agreed jobs will be communicated for volunteers to carry out.

effect: The volunteers have received their assigned stops and confirmed them by readback; the requests may still need completion.
reaction: The readback is a practical confirmation, not just a sent message.
reason: The working handset may be ready to coordinate the remaining request work; I'll inspect it rather than guess its next partner.
expectation: Its available partners will show how to proceed with the local requests.

effect: The inspection automatically connected the handset to the desk, producing replies and completing the remaining goal while keeping unfinished jobs visible.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the requests answered without treating a proposed solution as completed work.

mostWorthwhile.text: Using the neighbors' access notes to revise the rounds was most worthwhile: the volunteers changed both the staffing and priority of the upstairs carry.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial attempt to dispatch the receipted requests was frustrating because the apparently direct pairing did not work, although its compatibility feedback helped.

surprise.text: The appeal was accepted, but its three-working-day response time made clear it would not resolve the dawn problem.

arbitrary.text: The requests could not initially be paired with the dispatch handset; the required intermediate steps were not obvious to me at that point.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the neighborhood handles the dawn deadline; the combination of practical coordination and unresolved stakes held my interest.
